name: Sealed Note to Advisor Belgrum
summary: Historian Karnik's sealed note carries a warning from the Badlands to Advisor Belgrum. Its contents guide the next step against the Shadowforge dwarves.

sections.title: A Warning Carried
sections.body: In the Badlands, you carry Historian Karnik's note to Advisor Belgrum. Karnik asks you to tell Belgrum what you witnessed and seek his counsel. Meanwhile, Karnik turns to the spirit of Hammertoe, hoping it may help stop the Shadowforge dwarves' activities.

faq.answer: Historian Karnik sent the note to Advisor Belgrum.
The note is addressed to Advisor Belgrum.
Karnik says the note will explain what you witnessed and asks Belgrum for guidance on how to proceed.

faq.q: Why is Karnik sending the note?
faq.answer: Karnik wants Belgrum to hear what you witnessed and decide how they should proceed.

faq.q: What is Karnik doing while you carry it?
faq.answer: Karnik plans to speak with Hammertoe's spirit, hoping it can help stop the Shadowforge dwarves' activities in the Badlands.
